title: Save a proposed design version
responsibility: Save one immutable responsive mockup or behavior proposal for review.

inputs.name: planDesign.context
inputs.description: Prepared run context with the entity and thread, selected revision, planning port, agent runners, screenshot renderer, cancellation signal, and progress callbacks. The draft binds the current expected version and its source revision.

inputs.name: planDesign.prompt
inputs.description: Proposal text for a visual mockup or a headless design. The visual path uses it to author responsive HTML and CSS. The headless path stores it as behavior notes.
examples: Settings page with a compact header, grouped toggles and a primary Save button.
Two-column checkout layout with the order summary pinned to the right on desktop.
Retry failed syncs with exponential backoff and show a banner after three failed attempts.

outputs.name: planDesign
outputs.description: Resolves to Saved <version> for review after committing the version and appending the thread notice. Visual design versions include the HTML and CSS source and the rendered screenshots for their options.

errors.name: RunCancelled
errors.description: Thrown inside planDesign, which then rejects with it, when context.signal is aborted after an image or option generation returns or just before the save step. Nothing is saved in that case, because options are saved only through planning.addDesign at the end, and errors raised by generateImage or the planning port pass through unchanged.

inputs.name: planDesign.context
inputs.description: The prepared Plan run context, which the function reads and never assigns to: the entity (id, category, latestVersion, threads), the request (threadId, provider, model), the revision (commit, branch), imageModel, generator, planning port, session, signal, emit and run id. The entity, selected thread and revision set the draft's entity id, base revision, expected latest version, state and viewport, and the signal is passed to generation and checked after generation and before saving.

inputs.name: planDesign.prompt
inputs.description: The proposal text for this version. For pages, layouts and components it is passed to designPrompt to build the image instruction and also appears in the saved notes as the Proposal, while every other category keeps it unchanged as the draft notes and generates no image.
examples: Settings page with a compact header, grouped toggles and a primary Save button.
Two-column checkout layout with the order summary pinned to the right on desktop.
Retry failed syncs with exponential backoff and show a banner after three failed attempts.

outputs.name: planDesign
outputs.description: Resolves to the string 'Saved <version> for review.', where <version> is the version planning.addDesign saved, after its design event is emitted and the thread notice is appended. It rejects instead when RunCancelled is thrown or any generation, branch, save or notice call rejects, and the temporary directory for the run is removed in a finally block that covers those steps.

errors.name: RunCancelled
errors.description: Thrown inside planDesign, which then rejects with it, when context.signal is aborted after an image or option generation returns or just before the save step. Nothing is saved in that case, because options are saved only through planning.addDesign at the end, and errors raised by generateImage or the planning port pass through unchanged.
